name: fsearch
title: FSearch
description: Instant, typo-tolerant search of every file on your Mac, with filters, content search, and previews.
author: qunash

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Files
commands.subtitle: FSearch
commands.description: Search your Mac by filename or file contents

tools.name: search-files
tools.title: Search Files
tools.description: Finds files and folders on this Mac by name, or by text inside them, using fsearch's query syntax.

ai.instructions: Queries use fsearch syntax: plain words match file names with typo tolerance; ext:pdf, type:image, in:~/Downloads, mtime:<7d, size:>100mb filter; grep:text or regex:pattern search inside files. Prefer a short query plus filters. Paths in results are absolute; show them with the home folder shortened to ~ when listing for the user.

evals.input: @fsearch find PDF invoices in my Downloads folder
@fsearch show the largest video files on my Mac

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: FSearch Executable
preferences.description: Path to the fsearch executable. Leave it empty to look in ~/.local/bin, ~/.cargo/bin, and Homebrew's bin folders.

preferences.name: searchRoot
preferences.title: Search Folder
preferences.description: Optional folder to search within. Leave empty to search the whole index.

preferences.name: showDetails
preferences.title: Results
preferences.label: Show the preview pane by default
preferences.description: Open results in a split view with a file preview and metadata. Toggle it any time with ⌘ D.
